original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-etale-base-change-restriction-of-scalars}
Let $S$ be a scheme. Let $X \to Z \to B$ and $B' \to B$
be morphisms of algebraic spaces over $S$.
Set $Z' = B' \times_B Z$ and $X' = B' \times_B X$. Then
$$
\text{Res}_{Z'/B'}(X')
=
B' \times_B \text{Res}_{Z/B}(X)
$$
in $\Sh((\Sch/S)_{fppf})$.

final_content.statement:
For algebraic spaces $X\to Z\to B$ over $S$, the restriction-of-scalars functor $\operatorname{Res}_{Z/B}(X)$ sends $T\to B$ to the set of $Z$-morphisms $T\times_BZ\to X$. It is an fppf sheaf over $B$; there is a canonical square with $\operatorname{Mor}_B(Z,X)$ over $\operatorname{Mor}_B(Z,Z)$ and $\operatorname{Res}_{Z/B}(X)$ over $B$, the latter mapping into $\operatorname{Mor}_B(Z,Z)$ through the identity section of $Z$.

For a finite locally free morphism $Z\to U$ and an étale algebraic-space morphism $W\to Z$, the functor of sections $F(T)=\{\sigma:Z\times_UT\to W\times_UT\mid\sigma\text{ is a section over }Z\times_UT\}$ on $U$-schemes is an fppf sheaf. If $W\to Z$ is surjective, sections exist étale-locally on $U$.

Let $S$ be a scheme. Let $X' \to X \to Z \to B$ be morphisms of
algebraic spaces over $S$. Assume
\begin{enumerate}
\item $X' \to X$ is \'etale, and
\item $Z \to B$ is finite locally free.
\end{enumerate}
Then $\text{Res}_{Z/B}(X') \to \text{Res}_{Z/B}(X)$ is representable
by algebraic spaces and \'etale. If $X' \to X$ is also surjective,
then $\text{Res}_{Z/B}(X') \to \text{Res}_{Z/B}(X)$ is surjective.
